description: An arithmetic structure satisfies the induction axiom of \(\varphi(x,\bar y)\) exactly when every fixed parameter tuple satisfies its base-and-step implication.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.realize_induction_axiom.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] {k : ℕ}
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin k ⊕ Unit)) :
  M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.inductionAxiom φ ↔
    ∀ (a : Fin k → M),
      (φ.Realize (Sum.elim a fun x => Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) ∧
          ∀ (b : M),
            φ.Realize (Sum.elim a fun x => b) →
              φ.Realize (Sum.elim a fun x => Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M b)) →
        ∀ (b : M), φ.Realize (Sum.elim a fun x => b)
